2120987625125183840.en_summary: $CADL delaying filing of BLA until the middle of 2027. Company in dialogue with FDA on BLA for aglatimagene in prostate cancer. Plans to submit BLA mid-2027 due to assay refinement timelines. So much for repeated promises of a 2026 filing.
2120987625125183840.zh_summary: $CADL 將BLA申報延至2027年中。公司與FDA就前列腺癌aglatimagene的BLA進行對話。由於某些檢測改進的時間線，目前計劃在2027年中提交BLA。之前多次承諾2026年申報的說法落空了。
